sentences.en: Sandy Jones isn't Sandy Lee, as why people have surnames.
sentences.zh: 桑迪·琼斯并不是桑迪·李，因为人们都有姓。

sentences.en: We are not related. We just have the same surname.
sentences.zh: 我们没有亲戚关系。我们只是同姓而已。

sentences.en: On the poster, my surname is written in enormous letters.
sentences.zh: 海报上，我的姓用很大的字体写着。
